# Recorded Yahoo Finance responses

`<ticker>.json` is the response of `https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/<ticker>?period1=0&period2=1625097600&interval=1d` (every daily close before 2021-07-01, the tests' "today"), recorded on 2026-10-12 and trimmed to keep the repo small: points before 2021-03-01 removed. `meta` is left as recorded, so its market price and 52-week range are from 2026.
